## Before you submit

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] A bug fix in `packages/core` or the Figma converter has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] The output is still real HTML and Tailwind (nothing Windcraft-only ends up in a design)
- [ ] The pull request is small and about one thing
